description: Look up a Dutch municipality, town, district, neighbourhood, postcode, street or address by name and get its Huisly slug. Use the slug with search_listings (location), get_place_insights (type and slug) or, for an address, get_property (property_slug).

language.description: Language of huisly.nl links and of area-figure labels: en (default) or nl

query.description: A place name, postcode or address, e.g. 'Utrecht', '1012 AB' or 'Damrak 1 Amsterdam'

name: resolve_place
title: Find a Dutch place
